settings.title: Settings
settings.treeFileCountDesc: Display file counts in the folder tree; parent folders include all nested files
settings.semanticWorkbenchHint: Control the visibility and scope of the Semantic workbench entry in the sidebar.
settings.semanticWorkbenchEnabledDesc: When off, the sidebar hides the semantic entry; all data and compile results are preserved.
settings.semanticTabsHint: Choose which semantic categories stay in the sidebar; keep at least one.
settings.semanticIntensityHint: Intensity controls the confidence filter for conclusions, entities, and concepts.
settings.semanticIntensityDesc: Light shows only high-confidence items; Deep shows everything, including low-confidence and legacy data.
settings.typographyHint: Set font family and style separately for headings, body text, and quotes.
settings.modelHint: Used by built-in pipelines: ingest classification, survey generation, and RAG HyDE. CLI agents use their own API keys, separate from here.
settings.organizeRulesHint: Topic depth and survey policy. Topic structure comes from wiki/WIKI.md and is used automatically when classifying.
settings.organizeRulesTopicsHint: Current level-1 topics (from wiki/WIKI.md, synced with Notes/ folders):
settings.organizeRulesTopicsEmpty: (No topics yet — they appear after ingest)
settings.organizeRulesAutoSurveyDesc: Refresh stale surveys during ingest and Lint
settings.topicAutoThresholdHint: Default 0.80. Only a single AI topic suggestion at or above this threshold is filed automatically.
settings.mergePresetHint: Controls how strictly merge candidates are discovered: Conservative accepts only heavily overlapping notes, Aggressive includes more semantically related candidates. Applies when scanning merge candidates.
settings.mergeAdvancedHint: Empty fields keep the selected preset defaults; filled fields override the corresponding thresholds for both note and topic merge candidate scans.
settings.ingestAutoDesc: When on, opening a workspace or adding sources runs the ingest pipeline automatically. When off, ingest only runs manually.
settings.maintenanceHint: Re-convert PDF, Word, etc. in Raw/ to Markdown notes.
settings.ragIntro1: The Inspector AI tab uses topic tree + full-text search by default. Enable vector RAG for zvec hybrid recall (semantic + BM25) with reranking.
settings.cliIntro1: The Inspector CLI tab handles file operations: move notes, create topics, organize the vault. Runs a subprocess with the workspace as cwd.
settings.cliIntro2: CLI agents read AGENTS.md at the workspace root. Use CLI tab for file ops; use AI tab for knowledge Q&A.
settings.cliDefaultDesc: Auto-selected when opening the CLI tab. Only installed agents can be chosen.
settings.cliAgentsHint: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini, Kimi, etc. Install the CLI on your system, then click Refresh.
settings.cliVaultHint: Generate AGENTS.md so CLI agents understand the Notes / wiki / Raw layout and topic rules.
settings.ragModeDesc: Off (default): topic tree + full-text search, fewer dependencies. On: semantic search via vector index.
settings.ragAdvancedHint: Hybrid search, HyDE, and rerank settings. Auto-saved; clears the retrieval cache.
settings.ragHydeEnabledDesc: When top score is below threshold, LLM generates a hypothetical answer for a second search
settings.ragRerankEnabledDesc: Rerank candidates with bge-reranker (requires RAG component)
settings.componentsHint: Optional Python packages. RAG is installed by default; after removal, uv sync will not reinstall it until you download here. Restart the app after install or remove.
settings.componentRagDesc: fastembed embeddings and ONNX rerank, bm25s full-text, and zvec index.
settings.componentInstallDone: Installed. Restart the app to apply.
settings.componentRemoveDone: Component removed. Restart the app to apply.
settings.componentRemoveConfirm: Remove the RAG component? This uninstalls Python packages and turns off vector search.
settings.storageHint: These folders are local models and the workspace index, not the Tauri/WebView cache. Rerank is ONNX now; the legacy PyTorch cache can be cleared. Clearing a folder requires a re-download or rebuild next time. The project .venv is not removed.
settings.storageClearModelsConfirm: Delete the downloaded model cache ({size})? Notes stay. RAG will re-download on next use.
settings.storageClearIndexConfirm: Delete the workspace vector index ({size})? Notes stay. Semantic search needs a rebuild afterwards.
settings.indexHint: Only needed when vector RAG is enabled. Ingest updates it incrementally; a manual update repairs a missing or inconsistent index only when needed.
settings.activityLogHint: AI and ingest actions logged to wiki/log.md. Health check fixes broken links and stale surveys.
settings.aboutDesc: NoteAI helps you organize and manage Markdown notes with AI.
settings.aboutTechDesc: Rust desktop shell, Python AI sidecar, D3.js graph.
settings.reliabilityBackupHint: Packages Notes, wiki, Raw and workspace metadata (rebuildable indices and caches excluded). Indices are not backed up; rebuild after restore.
settings.reliabilityRestoreHint: Pick a NoteAI backup (zip) to restore into the current workspace. Existing Notes, wiki and Raw are moved into .trash first so an accidental restore can be undone.
settings.reliabilityRestoreConfirm: Restoring will replace Notes, wiki and Raw in the current workspace (previous content stays in .trash). Continue?
settings.reliabilityHealthHint: Checks RAG, semantic store, links and full-text indices; missing indices can be rebuilt with one click.
